newsitem.title: USA: NHL ICE HOCKEY-FLYERS' PETIT, CANUCKS' BRASHEAR SUSPENDED.
newsitem.headline: NHL ICE HOCKEY-FLYERS' PETIT, CANUCKS' BRASHEAR SUSPENDED.

text.p: Philadelphia Flyers defenceman Michel Petit and Vancouver Canucks left wing Donald Brashear were each suspended on Sunday pending hearings by the NHL into separate incidents in Saturday games.
Petit was suspended for kneeing Florida Panthers left wing Johan Garpenlov in a game at Florida. Garpenlov suffered a sprained right knee and will be sidelined up to six weeks.
Petit received a major penalty and a game misconduct on the play and missed Sunday night's game against the New York Rangers.

Brashear was suspended for delivering a blind-side punch to Los Angeles Kings centre Ian Laperriere in Saturday's game at Los Angeles. He received a major penalty for fighting and a game misconduct on the play.
Brashear missed Sunday night's game at Anaheim.
